turns.question: one csv is there. make a 2024 Monsoon block wise crop yield dashboard, tonnes per hectare highest first. i should see source and download the table
turns.sql: SELECT block, source, SUM(harvest_tonnes) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(cultivated_hectares), 0) AS tonnes_per_hectare FROM field_harvest WHERE year = 2024 AND season = 'Monsoon' GROUP BY block, source ORDER BY tonnes_per_hectare DESC

turns.question: now show 2023 and 2024 Monsoon tonnes per hectare trend for every block
turns.sql: SELECT block, year, SUM(harvest_tonnes) * 1.0 / NULLIF(NULLIF(SUM(cultivated_hectares), 0), 0) AS tonnes_per_hectare FROM field_harvest WHERE season = 'Monsoon' AND year IN (2023, 2024) GROUP BY block, year ORDER BY block NULLS FIRST, year NULLS FIRST

turns.question: only Bhojpur and Wardha now, compare change in tonnes per hectare from 2023 to 2024. keep source and download
turns.sql: WITH yearly AS (SELECT block, source, year, SUM(harvest_tonnes) * 1.0 / NULLIF(NULLIF(SUM(cultivated_hectares), 0), 0) AS tonnes_per_hectare FROM field_harvest WHERE season = 'Monsoon' AND year IN (2023, 2024) AND block IN ('Bhojpur', 'Wardha') GROUP BY block, source, year) SELECT a.block, a.source, a.tonnes_per_hectare AS t2023, b.tonnes_per_hectare AS t2024, b.tonnes_per_hectare - a.tonnes_per_hectare AS change FROM yearly AS a JOIN yearly AS b ON a.block = b.block AND a.source = b.source WHERE a.year = 2023 AND b.year = 2024 ORDER BY a.block NULLS FIRST, a.source NULLS FIRST
